source_semantics.review: Do not adopt the obsolete Angular17 prerelease dependency/tooling update. The complete package/lock changes raise framework ranges to next.5 and pin CLI/Devkit/schematics next.1 alongside transitive updates. Our exact private Node/pnpm/npm/compiler/peer pins and published consumer ranges remain independent. The portal spec changes ChocolateInjector.get to accept and forward notFoundValue for non-Chocolate tokens; all 39 complete case callbacks are equal but injector fallback behavior changes. Four owned public-constructor contexts already accept and forward notFoundValue through public Injector.NULL, without copying this test injector. Actual injector/default/lifetime and floor execution remains a separate obligation. No historical dependency install, peer-floor narrowing or advisory-clearance claim.
